text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around campus on my
break, I see
Sakura Chiyono O in the
shade.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Who's that over there? It looks like
Spe
aaand...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: M-Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, don'tcha just think it's a great day for a drive? It'll be a great way to chillax! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A drive?! Well, as long as we follow the
traffic
laws, sure!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...A ride with Maruzen. Wouldn't that be
nice...
choice_data_list: Why don't you ask for a ride too?
Why don't you ask for a ride too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, um, hello. No, I'm... fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Just fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious about why she seems so
downtrodden, I
ask her to explain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I get motion sick!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Chiyo! ♪ Wanna go for a drive to
the
beach?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're okay with me coming?! I'd love
to!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure I'll be fine. It's just a little ways
away...)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's floor it, babyyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...It was terrible. The motion sickness hit
me like a
truck.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you can guess what happened
next...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't invited me on a drive since.
I'm sure
she's just being considerate, but
it still sucks...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So it only makes sense that she'd invite
other
people instead of me. Besides, I
don't want to be
a bother.
choice_data_list: Are you going to keep holding back?
Are you going to keep holding back, then?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... I... Well, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... Well, the truth is that I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I really want to go for a drive with Maruzen! I miss her so much!
choice_data_list: Why don't you train so you don't get motion sick?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sniff... I did try to get used to riding different vehicles.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But when I think about what happened, I
get cold
feet and can't go through with
it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And every time I find myself acting like
that, I
feel like I'm drifting further and
further away from
Maruzen...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I shouldn't think like this.
choice_data_list: Let's do some research before jumping into practice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Research? ...Do you mean, like, looking
into what
causes my motion sickness?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right... Depending on the
cause, there
might be more suitable
methods I can use to
overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And it feels much better to do that than
to simply
sulk and envy others.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You know what they say! "Know the soil
before
you plant the flowers!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll try it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy for Sakura Chiyono O to
get over
her nausea, but she's taking the
first step towards
progress.
